retained_foundations.statement: Finite extensions of Q_l have finite complete DVR integer rings, identified by norm<=1; integrality and residue-field inclusions have their usual properties.

Local Galois automorphisms preserve norm, inertia fixes residues and prime-to-p roots of unity, closed subgroups have their fixed fields. The needed finite-character conjugation calculation itself is proved in JRP3.
Original finite-completion decomposition embedding of the Hida setting, preserving inertia/cyclotomic character and the given quotient map. The full D0/I0 consumer is proved in JRP5.
The source HypothesesH prime is retained exactly; its automorphic/local inputs enter through HEP12 and the already reconstructed ordinary algebra and density.

scope_note: Full literal TJRing producer under original H prime and numbered inherited human inputs. Source is provenance, not a proof substitute.
